description: Protect yourself, stay observant and proceed with caution #selflove #investinyourself #criticalthinking
transcript: Start protecting yourself like your life depends on it, because your life does depend on it. The safety nets and the parameters that you place around you keeps a protection shield between the external world and your internal world. Not everything has to have access to you. In order for something to gain access to you, it should have the password. If it does not have the password, that may be a problem.
